presence.online.description: Status in a device row: the device is connected right now. Lowercase, short.

presence.inactive.description: Status in a device row: the device has not been seen for a long time. Lowercase, short.

presence.lastSeen.description: Status in a device row: when the device was last seen. {ago} is a short relative time such as “5m ago” or “just now”. Lowercase, short.
